test_title: PYST 54: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 11 Nov, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: What sum (in ₹) will earn a simple interest of ₹360 in 3 years at 16% per year rate of interest?
solution:
**Given:**

Simple interest (SI) = ₹360

Time (T) = 3 years

Rate of interest (R) = 16% per year

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (Principal × Rate × Time) / 100

Principal = (SI × 100) / (Rate × Time)

**Calculation:**

Principal = (₹360 × 100) / (16 × 3)

Principal = ₹36000 / 48

Principal = ₹750

**The sum that will earn a simple interest of ₹360 in 3 years at a rate of 15% per year is ₹750.**
